headline: Failed House resolution would have directed the President to remove U.S. armed forces from Lebanon within seven days.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used the War Powers Resolution to direct the President to pull U.S. Armed Forces out of Lebanon. The removal would have had to happen within seven days after the resolution was adopted. The House voted it down on June 4, 2026.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. military service members in Lebanon
who_it_affects.how: They would have been required to leave Lebanon within seven days of the resolution's adoption.
The President would have been directed to remove U.S. forces from Lebanon on a set deadline.
